ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $AC=DB$, $AO=DO$, and $CD=300\,m$. What is the distance in meters between points $A$ and $B$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $AC=DB$ and $AO=DO$,

it follows that $BO=CO$.

In triangles $AOB$ and $DOC$,

\[
\left\{\begin{array}{l}
AO=DO\\
\angle AOB=\angle DOC\\
BO=CO
\end{array}\right.,
\]

thus $\triangle AOB \cong \triangle DOC$ (SAS),

therefore $AB=DC$.

Since $CD=300\,\text{m}$,

it follows that $AB=\boxed{300\,\text{m}}$,

which means the distance between points $A$ and $B$ is $300\,\text{m}$.
